params.body:
The failing list on the Sources page of 25 November 2026 held fourteen sources. #504 fixed what was the collector's (the rotation that left nine untried since 9 November, the bare "fetch failed"). This is the rest: a plan per source, checked by hand, for `bin/repair-sources.mjs`.

## The plan (`research/source-repairs-2026-11-25.json`)

| Source | Does | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Lebensmittel Zeitung | feed `lebensmittelzeitung.net/news/feed/` | the stored address is the HTML page listing their feeds |
| Dazed Korea | feed `dazedkorea.com/rss` | dazed.co.kr has no address in DNS |
| Gay Times | feed `gaytimes.com/rss/` | gaytimes.co.uk no longer answers |
| Gayming Magazine | feed `gaymingmag.com/feed/` | gayming-magazine.com has no address in DNS |
| Good On You | feed `goodonyou.eco/feed/` | goodonyou.org serves an empty page |
| Gorilla vs Bear | feed `gorillavsbear.net/feed/` | www. before the Blogger name, outside its certificate |
| Clash Music | feed `clashmusic.com/feed/` | the page answers 403, the feed answers |
| The Oxford Student | feed `oxfordstudent.com/feed/` | the page answers 403, the feed answers |
| Eye on Design | page `eyeondesign.aiga.org` | www. the name does not have; no feed |
| Neon | mute | page and feed answer 403 |
| The Balance Careers | mute | 403, and the feed at thebalancemoney.com too |
| Overt Magazine | mute | no address in DNS |
| Threads Magazine | mute | no address in DNS; Threads at threadsmagazine.com is a sewing magazine |

Jiskefet is left: one timeout, it answers again. Every feed was parsed with rss-parser and the collector's User-Agent on 25 November; each had items from the last week or so.

## What `repair-sources` learns

- `page`: reads a web-browse source at another address. Same row, state and history; failures from nought; the old address goes in its notes. A feed is not given a page address.
- A source is found by its exact address whatever its type, so a broken feed can be given its right one. By host it still finds pages only.

## Running it

Nothing changes until a person runs it, on the box:

```
node bin/repair-sources.mjs research/source-repairs-2026-11-25.json --by=<name>          # what it would do
node bin/repair-sources.mjs research/source-repairs-2026-11-25.json --by=<name> --apply
```

The four mutes are the desk's call: whoever runs it can drop them from the plan first.

`npm test`: 1832 pass. `tsc` clean.
params.title: Repair plan for the failing sources of 25 November
